line.comment: * called by ZH.Monitor
* Add-Ons 1.5.7: Update plot stage early. The wait statements can cause transients.
* Mordan8 - set a global indicating we connected the phanon up and that from now onwards, we won't 'automatically' convert player beacons to phanon ones.
* selecting 2 quest sectors that the player must conquer for Phanon
* Add-Ons 1.6: Sort function requires corresponding indices! One way to do this is to use for loop (not for each) and iterate from head to tail.
* Other approach is appending the tail to the new array (becomes the head).
* we want to choose 1 sector from each of the 2 largest factions. Note: DO NOT reverse array.
* for each statement will traverse from tail to head, and sort array has the selection in ascending order! This means the largest factions are at the tail!
* ** DEBUG ONLY **
* $t = 'races: ' + $races
* write to player logbook $t
* ** END DEBUG **
* we sort their sectors by average distance to player sectors in order to grab fairly distant sectors
* Add-Ons 1.6: Sort function requires corresponding indices!
* only core sectors
* no currently claimed sectors
* once we got our first target sector we switch to the second largest race

* Message: The OCV uses the quantum frequency between a pair of space anomalies to stabilize their Maelstrom. All Terraformers need a constant connection to the OCV overlord AI core on the other side of the portal.

* Our stations have jammers which can interfere with that. If we set up Phanon Outposts at those 2 locations the Maelstrom will collapse. This would cause the destruction of all Terraformers, including Phanon.
* We are willing to make this sacrifice. Our sectors and stations are yours once the deed is done
